summary.plain: The SND detector: three layers of sodium iodide crystals shaped into a sphere around the collision point, with drift chambers inside and muon counters outside.
summary.technical: SND: three-layer spherical NaI(Tl) calorimeter of 1632 crystals, 13.5 radiation lengths thick, total mass 3.6 t; cylindrical drift chambers for charged-particle tracking; muon/veto system of streamer tubes and scintillation counters.

technology.quote: The main part of the SND is a three layer spherical NaI(Tl) calorimeter, consisted of 1632 individual crystals.
technology.value: Three-layer spherical NaI(Tl) calorimeter of 1632 crystals (13.5 radiation lengths, 3.6 t) with inner cylindrical drift chambers and an outer muon/veto system
